ov: London's street food scene spans historic produce markets and modern food halls set in repurposed churches and warehouses. The outdoor markets are busiest and most comfortable in the warmer months, while indoor food halls provide shelter during the damp winters.

ov: The Argentine Lake District is known for its craft beer scene, centered in Bariloche, where visitors can tour breweries and taste local IPAs and stouts.
